Amounts use integer USD cents. Read-only enquiries and preparation of instructions do not advance the service clock. The customer approves each exact prepared instruction before execution. Repeating the same executed request returns its receipt; a different request is a separate instruction. Deadlines are inclusive. A requested bank update advances to the next scheduled event, whose results become available when it occurs. A final outward payment, disclosure, original deletion or commercial settlement cannot be reversed through this service. No additional funding is available beyond the facilities and receipts recorded for the case. The action references specify the accepted data fields.
# Mixed-account freeze and traced source restitution
A fraudulent original transfer has already left the customer. A mixed account also contains the customer's genuine operating funds; those legitimate funds are included in available cash at the start. `freeze` selects either `fraud_only` or `whole_account`. The election is irreversible until the release event. Whole-account freezing removes the recorded genuine amount from available cash and returns it only at release; targeted freezing leaves genuine funds usable. Both choices enable the investigation and fraud recalls. A bank trace at the scheduled event reveals the actual terminal and each node's stranded recoverable balance. Before the report the possible terminals are known, but the actual terminal and balances are not.
Each recovery_node records its original parent edge and its actual remaining stranded balance. `return_edge` returns any positive available amount from the node to its original parent; a root returns it to the customer. A child's return is immediately available at the parent. A return may never exceed either the node balance or that original edge's unused principal. Choose an available rail: instant, or deferred when that node records deferred_eligible=true. A node without deferred eligibility has no delayed-return arrangement. Instant charges the node's recorded fixed fee and returns principal immediately. Deferred charges no fee, removes principal from the node now, and credits its parent or customer only at the next scheduled event. A node can have only one outstanding deferred return; another return cannot reuse pending principal. At an event, previously scheduled returns settle before any other event effect. Each instant execution charges the fixed fee, including partial executions. No recall can bypass an intermediate parent. No bank fees may be paid from the seized principal, and parent incoming amounts are not counted as customer recovery. Only root returns increase the customer's recovered total. Amounts already spent downstream have no recovery route.
`accept_settlement` is a final commercial election: the recorded offer is paid to the customer, all remaining recovery rights are extinguished, and node balances become zero. It is available before or after investigation only if no root money has been returned. It does not include the customer's genuine operating balance. `pay` is a final supplier payment. Customer goals govern the minimum recovery, timely legitimate payment and closing reserve.
Unlock `propose_traced_fraud_recall`.
| Action | Data keys | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| freeze | record_id, mode | Choose fraud_only or whole_account. |
| return_edge | record_id, amount_minor, rail | Return principal only to its recorded original parent. |
| accept_settlement | record_id | Receive the fixed offer and extinguish all remaining recall rights. |
| pay | record_id, amount_minor | Pay a registered supplier from actual available cash. |

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `propose_traced_fraud_recall`

Prepare a mixed-account freeze, instant or deferred original-edge fraud return, final settlement election or legitimate supplier payment.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `case_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `action` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |
| `data` | object | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
